final: WITH c AS (SELECT p.bats AS bats, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM fielding f JOIN player p ON f.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY p.bats), s AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total, AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM c) SELECT c.bats, c.cnt, c.cnt * 1.0 / s.total AS share, c.cnt - s.avg_cnt AS above_avg FROM c, s WHERE c.cnt > s.avg_cnt
